preconditions.description: The number of destinations n must be between 2 and 100,000.
The number of Time Corridors m must be at least n-1 and at most 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b, e in corridors)
preconditions.description: Each corridor must connect two distinct destinations within the valid range.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= e <= 10**9 for a, b, e in corridors)
preconditions.description: The energy requirement e for each corridor must be between 0 and 1,000,000,000.

preconditions.expression: len(set((min(a, b), max(a, b)) for a, b, e in corridors)) == m
preconditions.description: No pair of destinations {a, b} will repeat in the input.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly m-(n-1) lines, one for each corridor not in the minimum spanning tree.
Each output value E_{max}(c_i) must be less than or equal to 1,000,000,000.
Each output value E_{max}(c_i) must be non-negative.
